description: Flat metadata schema for individual metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) reconstructed from environmental samples using short-read and long-read sequencing workflows, including assembly, binning, quality, and ecological context fields.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this MAG record within the dataset.

sample_id.descr: Identifier of the environmental sample from which this MAG was derived.

sample_collection_date.descr: Date when the environmental sample was collected (YYYY-MM-DD).

sample_environment.descr: General environment type of the source sample, such as soil, marine water, freshwater sediment, wastewater, gut, or activated sludge.

sample_location.descr: Geographic or site description of the sampling location, including site name or coordinates if available.

sample_depth_m.descr: Sampling depth in meters, if applicable.

sample_material.descr: Material or matrix sampled, such as sediment, water, biofilm, or soil.

sequencing_platform_short_read.descr: Short-read sequencing platform used, such as Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq, or MiSeq.

sequencing_platform_long_read.descr: Long-read sequencing platform used, such as Oxford Nanopore or PacBio.

short_read_library_layout.descr: Short-read library layout, such as paired-end or single-end.

long_read_library_type.descr: Long-read library type or chemistry, if available.

read_trimming_tool.descr: Software used to trim or filter sequencing reads before assembly.

read_trimming_version.descr: Version of the read trimming software.

read_trimming_parameters.descr: Key parameters used for read trimming, filtering, or adapter removal, recorded as a text string.

error_correction_tool.descr: Software used for read error correction prior to assembly.

error_correction_version.descr: Version of the error correction software.

error_correction_parameters.descr: Key parameters used for error correction, recorded as a text string.

assembly_tool.descr: Primary assembler used to generate the contigs or metagenomic assembly, such as MEGAHIT, metaSPAdes, Flye, or hybrid assemblers.

assembly_mode.descr: Assembly strategy used, such as short-read only, long-read only, or hybrid assembly.

assembly_parameters.descr: Key assembly parameters and settings recorded as a text string.

polishing_tool.descr: Software used to polish or refine the assembled contigs, if applicable.

polishing_parameters.descr: Key polishing parameters recorded as a text string.

binning_tool.descr: Software used to bin contigs into MAGs, such as MetaBAT2, MaxBin, CONCOCT, or VAMB.

binning_parameters.descr: Key binning parameters recorded as a text string.

manual_curation_performed.descr: Indicates whether manual curation or refinement of the MAG was performed after automated binning.

taxonomic_assignment.descr: Taxonomic classification assigned to the MAG, preferably at the highest confident rank available.

taxonomy_method.descr: Method or database used for taxonomic assignment, such as GTDB-Tk, Kraken2, or marker-gene placement.

completeness_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness expressed as a percentage from 0 to 100.

contamination_percent.descr: Estimated genome contamination expressed as a percentage from 0 to 100.

strain_heterogeneity_percent.descr: Estimated strain heterogeneity or relatedness metric expressed as a percentage, if reported.

n50_bp.descr: Assembly N50 in base pairs for the MAG or source assembly.

largest_contig_bp.descr: Length in base pairs of the largest contig in the MAG or source assembly.

total_length_bp.descr: Total assembled genome length in base pairs.

num_contigs.descr: Number of contigs included in the MAG.

gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the MAG expressed as a percentage.

coverage_short_read.descr: Average short-read sequencing coverage across the MAG, if available.

coverage_long_read.descr: Average long-read sequencing coverage across the MAG, if available.

coverage_units.descr: Units used for coverage measurements, typically x, reads per base, or fold coverage.

quality_category.descr: Overall MAG quality designation, such as high-quality, medium-quality, low-quality, or draft.

quality_passed_threshold.descr: Indicates whether the MAG meets the study-defined quality thresholds for inclusion in downstream analyses.

quality_threshold_definition.descr: Text description of the thresholds used to classify MAG quality, such as minimum completeness and maximum contamination.

marker_gene_set.descr: Marker gene set used to assess genome quality, such as single-copy bacterial or archaeal markers.

functional_annotation_tool.descr: Software or pipeline used for functional annotation of the MAG, if performed.

functional_annotation_version.descr: Version of the functional annotation tool.

functional_annotation_database.descr: Reference database used for functional annotation, such as KEGG, eggNOG, Pfam, or CAZy.

predicted_metabolic_potential.descr: Concise textual summary of notable metabolic capabilities inferred from annotation, if available.

ecological_role.descr: Ecological interpretation of the MAG, such as decomposer, methanogen, nitrifier, or symbiont, if inferred.

assembly_accession.descr: Public database accession for the assembly or MAG, if deposited.

raw_reads_accession.descr: Public accession or identifier for the raw sequencing reads associated with this MAG.

pipeline_name.descr: Name of the bioinformatics pipeline used to generate the MAG, if a standardized pipeline was applied.

pipeline_version.descr: Version of the MAG reconstruction pipeline.
